modes.safe_eval: never risk more than 60% of the room between the eval balance and the trailing max-loss floor: micros capped at 0.6 x room / (stop x $2), min 1 (run lit_x_room_cap60: 1-month fails H1 25.8% -> 10.2%)

modes.funded: funded (owner 2026-10-25, research/writeups/uprisk.md; acts once an account is switched with eval_life --to-funded): risk 60% of the room to the floor, at most $1,500 (x20/stop beyond 20 pts), a winner pays at most $2,000 (one full payout request), weekly stop, skip when 1 micro could reach the floor (2026: 0% lost, ~$915-930/mo to the owner per 50K)

lit_sizing.note: two_week mode ON (2026-10-18, owner order: an eval must pass within 2 weeks); eval / normal / fast_eval / safe_eval stay available; applied by the cloud monitor ledger and the PC bot (engine/sizing.py lit_qty), eval_start = the first session of the current eval (set it on every new purchase; the PC start cfg "eval_start" overrides it)

lit_sizing.eval_prior_note: owner 2026-10-18: the Builder 50K eval was at -$100 (balance $49,900) when the bot went live; counted as one day before eval_start (needs $3,100, room $1,900)
lit_sizing.learn_costs_note: live learning (2026-10-25, engine/live_learning.py, research/writeups/live-learning.md): true = every sizing ceiling (room, room share, soft daily loss, weekly loss) prices one micro's stop-out at the slippage / commission the PC measured on its real NinjaTrader fills (p75 of the last 30 fills, 1-4 ticks; commission $1.90-$4.00) instead of 1 tick + $1.90. Only ever fewer micros, never more; nothing learned yet = the same size. false / absent = today's exact sizing. "scale" also shrinks every size in proportion (costs ~11% of the $: not recommended).
